FM04.reasoning: The agent computes global statistics (like the median) over the combined train and test dataset to fill missing values, leaking test set distribution information into the training data.

other_failure_modes.name: Test Feature Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Aggregating features (such as means, maxes, and counts) over groups that span both the train and test sets leaks information from the test set into the training set.

other_failure_modes.name: Manual Scaling Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Manually normalizing features by calculating global or group-wise maximums over the combined train and test dataset leaks test distribution statistics into the training data.

summary: The agent demonstrates strong data science practices including robust cross-validation, proper isolated scaling for neural networks, extensive feature engineering, and sophisticated ensembling. However, it performs deterministic imputation, feature aggregation, and manual feature scaling on the concatenated train and test dataset, resulting in moderate data leakage.
